items.title: The sheaf condition is the bijectivity of the map to Cech H-0 for every covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises abelian sheaves among abelian presheaves on a site: the presheaf is a sheaf exactly when, for every covering, the natural map F(U) -> Cech H^0(U, F) is bijective (statement lines 850-864). The proof is the observation that Cech H^0 computes compatible families of local sections, so injectivity of the displayed map is the separation property and surjectivity is the gluing property, whose conjunction is the sheaf condition (proof lines 867-869). The content is the identification of the map, which is why the author can keep the proof to one sentence. The claim is H2: a definitional identification, stated rather than computed.
